scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:blockbench
scripts.test:web: npm --workspace @ashfox/web run test && npm run test:engine-core
scripts.test:blockbench: npm --workspace @ashfox/blockbench-runtime run test && npm run test:blockbench:conformance
scripts.test:practical:blockbench: npm --workspace @ashfox/blockbench-runtime run test:practical && npm --workspace @ashfox/blockbench-conformance run test:practical
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:web && npm run test:blockbench
scripts.quality: npm run test:cov:blockbench && npm run test:blockbench:conformance && npm run test:web && npm run build && npm run quality:check && npm run quality:deadcode && npm run quality:coverage && npm run quality:audit && npm run release:validate
